Cooking mode · round 3 · the converged design

Designer C's base with the grafts from A and B, resized under owner decision C1: nothing is massive. One focus line at the 28 pt title size: the first line the cook has not ticked, or the line they tapped. The rest of the step under "Then" at 17. The soonest timer is the only other 28. The next step shows once, in the Next button. Controls are normal app sizes. Lemon and thyme roast chicken, 6 steps, for 4. Every screen is drawn at phone 390 (light and dark), tablet 834 and 1194, and web 1280 and 768.

Before you start: the timed lines, servings, and the alarm permission, asked once.

A step. The first unticked line is the focus, at 28; the rest sit under Then at 17. Next shows step 3 once.

After two ticks: one true record, and the focus is the first unticked line.

A cook who works without ticking taps line 3. It becomes the focus line. Nothing is ticked, and the lines it passed stay above it.

Every line ticked: step 4 takes the focus as a preview, and the button starts it.

A wait: "Nothing needs you for about 35 min", the turn offered as a timer, and two get-ready jobs.

Two timers: the headline names the timer, not its number. The soonest timer is the big number, in the dock.

A get-ready job in progress: a plain tick row in the wait, one control, and the place never leaves step 4.

Step 5, after the get-ready jobs: the measured flour and stock show as ready.

A finished timer in the app: the whole screen turns over once.

A finished timer on a locked phone: the system alarm.

Alarms are off: one honest line while a timer runs.

Ingredients from any step: Now, Later, In already, with the stepper on top.

All steps, opened from "Step 4 of 6": each timer under its step. The roast runs long: "checking", never "late".

Done: a short, calm end.
